concerns.text: The plan does not cite any verified, openly downloadable dataset containing hydrogen diffusion coefficients with the required compositional and microstructural descriptors. FR‑001 requires a real input dataset; the current “no verified open source” stance and the placeholder exit‑on‑missing‑data behavior mean the research question cannot be answered. The spec must be amended to name a concrete, accessible dataset (or formally authorize a documented manual data‑entry process) before the pipeline can produce valid results.
